mapper.select: SELECT id,subject_type,subject_id,certificate_type,expires_on,updated_at,version FROM operation_certificate WHERE subject_type=#{type} AND subject_id=#{id} ORDER BY certificate_type

SELECT c.sourceType,c.sourceId,c.cycleKey,c.stage,c.fleetId,c.subjectType,c.subjectId,c.title,c.dueDate,c.dueOdometerKm FROM ( SELECT 'CERTIFICATE' AS sourceType,b.id AS sourceId,CAST(b.expires_on AS CHAR) AS cycleKey, CASE WHEN b.expires_on<#{today} THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN b.expires_on=#{today} THEN 'DUE' ELSE 'DUE_SOON' END AS stage,COALESCE(v.fleet_id,u.fleet_id) AS fleetId, b.subject_type AS subjectType,b.subject_id AS subjectId,b.certificate_type AS title, b.expires_on AS dueDate,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS dueOdometerKm FROM operation_certificate b LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON b.subject_type='VEHICLE' AND v.id=b.subject_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON b.subject_type='DRIVER' AND u.id=b.subject_id AND u.role='DRIVER' WHERE b.expires_on<=#{soon} ) c WHERE c.fleetId IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM operation_reminder r WHERE r.source_type=c.sourceType AND r.source_id=c.sourceId AND r.cycle_key=c.cycleKey AND r.stage=c.stage) ORDER BY c.dueDate,c.sourceId LIMIT 200

SELECT c.sourceType,c.sourceId,c.cycleKey,c.stage,c.fleetId,c.subjectType,c.subjectId,c.title,c.dueDate,c.dueOdometerKm FROM ( SELECT 'MAINTENANCE' AS sourceType,p.id AS sourceId,CAST(p.cycle AS CHAR) AS cycleKey, IF(p.next_date<=#{today} OR o.odometer_km>=p.next_odometer_km,'DUE','DUE_SOON') AS stage, v.fleet_id AS fleetId,'VEHICLE' AS subjectType,p.vehicle_id AS subjectId,p.name AS title, p.next_date AS dueDate,p.next_odometer_km AS dueOdometerKm FROM vehicle_maintenance_plan p JOIN vehicle v ON v.id=p.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_odometer o ON o.vehicle_id=p.vehicle_id WHERE p.enabled=1 AND (p.next_date<=#{soon} OR o.odometer_km+#{kmWindow}>=p.next_odometer_km) ) c WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM operation_reminder r WHERE r.source_type=c.sourceType AND r.source_id=c.sourceId AND r.cycle_key=c.cycleKey AND r.stage=c.stage) ORDER BY c.sourceId LIMIT 200
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO operation_reminder(source_type,source_id,cycle_key,stage,fleet_id,subject_type, subject_id,title,due_date,due_odometer_km,created_at) SELECT #{c.sourceType},#{c.sourceId},#{c.cycleKey},#{c.stage},#{c.fleetId},#{c.subjectType}, #{c.subjectId},#{c.title},#{c.dueDate},#{c.dueOdometerKm},#{now} WHERE (#{c.sourceType}='CERTIFICATE' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM operation_certificate WHERE id=#{c.sourceId} AND expires_on=#{c.dueDate})) OR (#{c.sourceType}='MAINTENANCE' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM vehicle_maintenance_plan WHERE id=#{c.sourceId} AND enabled=1 AND CAST(cycle AS CHAR)=#{c.cycleKey}))
mapper.select: SELECT id,source_type,source_id,cycle_key,stage,fleet_id,subject_type,subject_id,title,due_date,due_odometer_km,created_at FROM operation_reminder WHERE (#{filter.fleetId} IS NULL OR fleet_id=#{filter.fleetId}) AND (#{filter.sourceType} IS NULL OR source_type=#{filter.sourceType}) AND (#{filter.sourceId} IS NULL OR source_id=#{filter.sourceId}) AND (#{filter.subjectType} IS NULL OR subject_type=#{filter.subjectType}) AND (#{filter.subjectId} IS NULL OR subject_id=#{filter.subjectId}) AND (#{filter.stage} IS NULL OR stage=#{filter.stage}) AND (#{filter.createdFrom} IS NULL OR created_at>=#{filter.createdFrom}) AND (#{filter.createdTo} IS NULL OR created_at<#{filter.createdTo}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE operation_certificate SET expires_on=#{input.expiresOn},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{input.expectedVersion}
